title: Compatible groupoid-valued deformation systems over a cofinal ideal filtration
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring, $k$ a field of finite type over $R$, $C$ a complete Noetherian local $R$-algebra with specified residue field $k$, and $\mathcal F$ a category cofibred in groupoids on the marked Artinian test category $\mathcal C_{R,k}$ [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category]. A cofinal ideal filtration of $C$ is a decreasing sequence $(I_n)_{n\geq1}$ of proper ideals such that for every $r\geq1$ some $I_n\subseteq\mathfrak m_C^r$ and for every $n$ some $\mathfrak m_C^r\subseteq I_n$. Set $B_n=C/I_n$ with its induced residue marking and canonical quotient maps $q_{m,n}:B_m\to B_n$ for $m\geq n$. A compatible system consists of $u_n\in\mathcal F(B_n)$ and isomorphisms $\tau_{m,n}:(q_{m,n})_*u_m\xrightarrow{\sim}u_n$, with $\tau_{n,n}$ the transport unit and $\tau_{l,n}$ the composite of $\tau_{l,m}$ and $\tau_{m,n}$ using the transport composition isomorphism. Arrows are families $a_n:u_n\to v_n$ satisfying $(q_{m,n})_*a_m;\tau^v_{m,n}=\tau^u_{m,n};a_n$. Componentwise identity and composition make these systems a groupoid. For a test arrow $f:B_n\to A$, its composite with the quotient projection is the marked local map $C\to A$; a commuting square of such factorizations gives the comparison between transported components by the transport composition constraints and $\tau_{m,n}$.
